text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Unity Cup's third preseason
match
behind us, not only has our
teamwork improved,
but each individual
member's skills have also
grown
significantly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, there is one major
problem—the team
as a whole has begun
to lose its confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And I think I know the reason why...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Time for your running drills. Get into
starting
positions within 30 seconds.

text_block_list.name: Team Zenith
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Huff... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
The fundamentals are important for a
reason. I
want you all to be conscious of
what you're trying
to improve and train
with intention.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
1,000 meters left! Your pace is slowing!
Raise the
cadence of your steps!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Your form's becoming sloppy! Straighten
up from
your core and go faster! Come
on!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Y-yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto's training is so intense
that there's
barely any time for her team
to breathe, much
less engage in idle
chitchat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Team Zenith is completing all
their
exercises with fervor.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow! They're really giving it their all!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's almost scary seeing how serious they
are...
Can we really beat them?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Team Zenith's training is terrifying in
more ways
than one, and the mere sight
of them practicing
has sent more than a
few Umamusume into
despair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We haven't been slacking off either,
though.
After all the work we've done,
I'm pretty sure we
could hold our own
against them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You wish for our teams to have a
practice match?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, we've competed against you
once
already, albeit in an unofficial
capacity.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
But I think this would be a good
opportunity to
see how far both teams
have come. Very well, I
accept.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We discuss a few more details and wrap
things up,
but just as Ms. Kashimoto
makes to leave...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I couldn't help but overhear! It's
been a
while—haven't seen you since our
unofficial
match!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
You want to race against us again?
Wasn't the
last time enough of a lesson?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
You're the ones who prioritized fun and
freedom
over actual improvement. Say
what you want, but
I bet your team's still
slow as molasses.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Sorry, please just ignore her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon's words are beyond acrid,
but I can't
really fault her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering how brutal their training is
under Ms.
Kashimoto, it's only natural
for her to feel
resentful toward teams
with looser schedules.
Still...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Almost all the students are against Ms.

Kashimoto's restrictive methods, so it
strikes me
as odd how willingly Team
Zenith accepts them.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
I don't really care. As long as I can get
faster, it
doesn't matter if what I'm
subjected to is fun or
not.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto can be harsh, but she
gets the
job done. I trust her methods.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I agree!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd already suspected it from observing
their
training, but it seems the members
of Team
Zenith really do all look up to
Ms. Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A p-p-practice match against Team
Zenith?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But they completely steamrolled us the
last time
we raced them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell them to have more confidence in
themselves
and that we'll definitely be
able to hold our
ground against Team
Zenith this time.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Darn tootin'! You said it! We're more
close-knit
an' a better team than ever
now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh! Very well! I know I have all of
you to lean
on, so I'll do my best too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, our days of training for the
practice
match begin!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Rice, your pace's droppin'! Pick it back
up!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
278, 279, 280! Just a little bit more,
Rice!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Um... Uh-oh, what number were we on
again?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Uh... I don't remember!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Siiigh... I'm terrified just thinking about the prospect of losing!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... I actually feel really nervous too...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oho! That makes us two peas in a pod,
Rice! How
nice it is that we're both
feeling the same way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I have an idea. Why don't we cast some

confidence-inducing spells on ourselves?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Wow! I ran a new personal best!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And, um... I wanted to say that training
has been
really fun recently.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Seeing everyone doing their best makes
me want
to work harder too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The team's strength grows steadily as
they all
work together, lend each other
support, and
engage in the occasional
friendly competition.
